## About the Event

The Department of IT (Computer Science and Business Systems), Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (Autonomous) is organizing a two-day National level students’ technical symposiumTECHKRITI-2026on 16thand 17thOctober 2026. Technical events such as Poster Presentation, Tech Treasure Hunt, Image Prompting, Code Debug and Risk Poly are organized by the students of IT under the guidance of the faculty of the Department.
